label: ASE
title: Door opening and gap traversal
description: CEM-LJS steers a frozen ASE humanoid to open a door, jump across a 0.8 m gap, and land in stable standing.

label: FB-MEBE
title: Quadruped box pushing
description: CEM-LJS steers a frozen FB-MEBE quadruped to push a 5.5 kg box 1.49 m, stop 1.71 cm from the target, and hold its position.

label: SPiRL
title: Cube retrieval and cabinet closure
description: CEM-LJS steers a frozen SPiRL skill decoder to open the cabinet, grasp and extract the cube, carry it beneath the door, and close the cabinet.

label: Isaac Sim
title: Breadbox pick, carry and place
description: CEM-LJS steers the same frozen BFM-Zero humanoid in a different simulator, PhysX, to lift a bread box from one platform, carry it, and set it down on another.
